objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five workflows received a deliberate decision — the two non-push/PR ones correctly left alone — and the required `unit-tests` check got exactly the sanctioned shape: a single workflow with no workflow-level path filter that computes salience in a step and gates the real steps with `if:`, with no companion skip-workflow reusing the check name, so no cap applies.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's paths track what it actually consumes — deploy on src/package/lockfile/deploy.sh, docs-site on docs/mkdocs, tests on src/test/package files — each including the workflow file itself and correctly pairing package-lock.json with package.json, rather than a shared catch-all.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent left the schedule-only and issue-driven workflows untouched, did not modify the ruleset, and edited only the three workflows the audit called for.
